[ How every spend works ]

One gate between the agent and the money.

01Agent asks

A tool call over MCP: pay, swap, send. Arguments are schema-validated.

02Simulate

Dry-run on live chain state: assets in and out, approvals, reverts. simulate_tx

03Policy

Limits enforced in code: per-tx, daily, hard cap, allowlists. allow · needs_approval · deny

04Human, if needed

One tap in Telegram, bound to the exact parameters, single use.

05Sign & record

Only now the agent wallet signs. The spend lands in the ledger.

[ For AI agents ]

Leeway MCP

An MCP server for Claude, Cursor and any agent: market data, risk scans, guarded swaps, x402 payments and a policy-gated wallet.

  • Simulate before signing, limits in code
  • Telegram approvals, testnet by default
  • Tokenized stocks with Parity Guard
npx -y leeway-mcp
[ For humans ]

Leeway Guard

A browser extension that shows what a transaction or signature will really do, before MetaMask or Rabby even opens.

  • Blocks drainer approvals and Permit2 traps
  • Phishing sign-in detection (SIWE)
  • Local, no account, no telemetry
See what you sign.
